# A 16 x 8-bit ROM preloaded through the artifact's memBuffer/memLoad exports
# (the `mem` preamble), then read by address. Word i holds i * 0x11, so the
# byte read back at address n is nn in hex.
mem code 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff
pc=0000 => out=00000000
pc=0011 => out=00110011
pc=1010 => out=10101010
pc=1111 => out=11111111
